entries.title: Add files to a message
entries.body: Drop files on the main input or a card reply, or choose them with Add files. Pictures and text files stay with the message. A file the app cannot attach is written in as its location on disk.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: Rest on a Tasks row to see its summary
entries.body: Rest on a planned, idle or done Tasks row. The same summary you see for a crewmate opens beside the row, and a click still opens the record.

picture.alt: The summary that opens beside a planned row in Tasks while the pointer rests on it

entries.title: A message with no action is tried once more
entries.body: If a message of yours gets no action, Firstmate tries once more. It then shows a note with your words, and you can ask again or leave it.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: Ask Firstmate to bring a closed card forward
entries.body: Ask Firstmate to show a closed card. It brings that same card forward to read, and nothing on it runs.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: An approved design reaches the builder intact
entries.body: An approved design now reaches the builder in words and as pictures it can open. That build is no longer sent to a weaker model.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the builder now receives the design in words and pictures.

entries.title: A revised card keeps the marks you saw
entries.body: When a card you have seen is revised, the app tells its author which parts changed. The marks you already saw can stay.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: An approved build names who does the work next
entries.body: After you approve a build, the card names who does the work next. It also says no further approval is needed.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: Codex at 1% used no longer reads as used up
entries.body: A Codex allowance at 1% used was shown as used up, so another provider was offered. It now reads as 1% used, and the allowance stays available.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

exclusions.reason: Documentation only: history sections were removed from lasting docs and the rules rewritten in the present tense. Nothing in the shipped app changed.
